content: # Recreational Boating Dashboard 1: Monthly Sales (units & value) with YoY comparison # Source: Kevin Decker | recreational boating dashboards library(shiny) library(readr) # ---- Data ---------------------------------------------------------------- # Expects a CSV with columns: year, month (1-12), units, value sales <- read_csv("boat_sales.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) month_names <- c("January","February","March","April","May","June", "July","August","September","October","November","December") # The newest month(s) in the data are still filling in (weekly upload lag), so the # dashboard opens on the latest COMPLETE month rather than the newest partial one. # If the lag ever exceeds one month, bump this to 2, 3, ... incomplete_trailing_months <- 1 sales_ord <- sales[order(sales$year, sales$month), ] default_idx <- max(1, nrow(sales_ord) - incomplete_trailing_months) default_year <- sales_ord$year[default_idx] default_month <- sales_ord$month[default_idx] # Rolling 12-month (R12 / trailing-twelve-months). Anchored to the latest complete # month. Reindexed to a gap-free monthly series spanning ALL the data, so each window # is a true 12 calendar months even if a month (or a source in a month) is missing. all_month_dates <- seq(min(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", sales_ord$year, sales_ord$month))), max(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", sales_ord$year, sales_ord$month))), by = "month") make_r12 <- function(df) { sdate <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", df$year, df$month)) full <- data.frame(date = all_month_dates) full$units <- df$units[match(full$date, sdate)]; full$units[is.na(full$units)] <- 0 full$value <- df$value[match(full$date, sdate)]; full$value[is.na(full$value)] <- 0 n <- nrow(full) ru <- rv <- rep(NA_real_, n) if (n >= 12) for (i in 12:n) { ru[i] <- sum(full$units[(i - 11):i]); rv[i] <- sum(full$value[(i - 11):i]) } end_i <- max(1, n - incomplete_trailing_months) # latest complete month list(full = full, ru = ru, rv = rv, end_i = end_i, n = n, monthly = df) } R12_all <- make_r12(sales_ord) # Monthly totals by source (written by prepare_data.R). Optional: the Trends tab # shows a note if it hasn't been generated yet. by_source <- if (file.exists("boat_sales_by_source.csv")) { read_csv("boat_sales_by_source.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) } else NULL # Plain-language definitions of each Source of Sales category. # The order here also drives the dropdown order (New -> Used -> In-Migrant). source_defs <- c( "New Import" = "a new boat purchased from an out-of-state dealer.", "New Dealer" = "a new boat purchased from a WA dealer.", "Used Dealer" = "a used boat purchased from a WA dealer.", "Used Dealer Import" = "a used boat purchased from an out-of-state dealer.", "Used Import" = "a used boat purchased from an out-of-state private seller.", "Used Private" = "a used boat purchased from a WA private seller.", "In-Migrant" = "a new WA resident registers a boat brought into WA." ) # Categories to offer, in the definition order above; any unexpected value in the # data (e.g. a new or misspelled label) is appended so nothing is hidden. source_levels <- if (is.null(by_source)) character(0) else { present <- unique(by_source$source) c(names(source_defs)[names(source_defs) %in% present], sort(setdiff(present, names(source_defs)))) } # Quick picks for the Rolling 12-Mo source filter. r12_presets <- list( all = source_levels, new = intersect(c("New Import", "New Dealer"), source_levels), used_dealer = intersect(c("Used Dealer", "Used Dealer Import"), source_levels) ) # All-source monthly totals keyed "YYYY-MM" — used for a fixed axis ceiling and for # looking up the same month a year earlier (the prior-year reference). all_tot <- if (is.null(by_source)) NULL else { a <- aggregate(cbind(units, value) ~ year + month, data = by_source, FUN = sum) a$ym <- sprintf("%04d-%02d", a$year, a$month) a } # Month start-dates spanning the data, for the Transaction Date range slider. month_dates <- sort(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", sales$year, sales$month))) date_min <- min(month_dates) # Stop the slider at the latest COMPLETE month — the newest still-filling month(s) # are excluded (same rule / setting as the Dashboard default) until they finish. last_complete_idx <- max(1, length(month_dates) - incomplete_trailing_months) date_max <- month_dates[last_complete_idx] # Default to roughly the most recent 13 complete months, like the reference view. default_start <- if (last_complete_idx >= 13) month_dates[last_complete_idx - 12] else date_min # ---- Explore tab data ------------------------------------------------------ # One row per transaction, written by run_weekly.R. Contains no VIN, make, or ZIP. # Optional: the Explore tab shows a note if the file hasn't been generated yet. records <- if (file.exists("boat_sales_records.rds")) readRDS("boat_sales_records.rds") else NULL # Filterable attributes: label shown to users = column in the records file. explore_dims <- c( "Source of Sales" = "source", "Boat Type" = "boat_type", "Length Class" = "length_class", "Hull Material" = "hull", "Engine Drive" = "engine", "Propulsion" = "propulsion", "Fuel" = "fuel", "Moorage County" = "moor_county" ) # The 15 coastal counties WSG serves (used by the "Coastal counties" quick pick). coastal_counties <- c( "Clallam", "Grays Harbor", "Island", "Jefferson", "King", "Kitsap", "Mason", "Pacific", "Pierce", "San Juan", "Skagit", "Snohomish", "Thurston", "Wahkiakum", "Whatcom" ) # Bars based on fewer boats than this are grayed out as less reliable. small_n <- 10 explore_choices <- if (is.null(records)) NULL else lapply(explore_dims, function(col) { x <- records[[col]] lv <- if (is.factor(x)) levels(droplevels(x)) else sort(unique(x)) if (col == "source") lv <- c(names(source_defs)[names(source_defs) %in% lv], setdiff(lv, names(source_defs))) if ("Unknown" %in% lv) lv <- c(setdiff(lv, "Unknown"), "Unknown") lv }) # Price ranges for the "Most common combinations" section. price_band_breaks <- c(-Inf, 0.5, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000, 250000, Inf) price_band_labels <- c("$0", "Under $10K", "$10K to $25K", "$25K to $50K", "$50K to $100K", "$100K to $250K", "$250K or more") if (!is.null(records)) records$price_band <- factor( as.character(cut(records$price, price_band_breaks, price_band_labels, right = FALSE)), levels = price_band_labels) combo_dims <- c( "Boat Type" = "boat_type", "Length Class" = "length_class", "Hull Material" = "hull", "Engine Drive" = "engine", "Propulsion" = "propulsion", "Fuel" = "fuel", "Price Range" = "price_band" ) boat_type_colors <- c( "Open Motorboat" = "#6aa84f", "Personal" = "#45818e", "Cabin Motorboat" = "#e69138", "Pontoon Boat" = "#76a5af", "Inflatable Boat" = "#38761d", "Auxiliary Sail" = "#6fa8dc", "Sail Only" = "#e06666", "Rowboat" = "#cc4125", "Paddlecraft" = "#f1c232", "Houseboat" = "#f6b26b", "Airboat" = "#3d5a99", "Other" = "#a68a3c", "Unknown" = "#999999" ) comma <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",") fmt_short_money <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) "—" else if (abs(x) >= 1e6) paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1), "M") else paste0("$", comma(x)) ym_to_date <- function(ym) as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", ym %/% 12L, ym %% 12L + 1L)) date_to_ym <- function(d) as.integer(format(d, "%Y")) * 12L + as.integer(format(d, "%m")) - 1L # ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------- get_row <- function(df, yr, mo) { r <- df[df$year == yr & df$month == mo, ] if (nrow(r) == 0) return(NULL) r[1, ] } pct_change <- function(now, last) { if (is.null(last) || is.na(last) || last == 0) return(NA_real_) (now - last) / last * 100 } fmt_int <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) "—" else format(round(x), big.mark = ",") fmt_money <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) "—" else paste0("$", format(round(x), big.mark = ",")) fmt_pct <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) "—" else sprintf("%+.1f%%", x) # ---- Branding ------------------------------------------------------------ WSG_PURPLE <- "#4b2e83" # Washington Sea Grant purple # Header mark: use the logo if ANY image is in the www/ folder (Shiny serves www/), # preferring a logo-ish name; otherwise fall back to a text badge. So just drop the # Sea Grant Washington image into a "www" folder next to app.R — any name/format works. logo_file <- local({ if (!dir.exists("www")) return(NA_character_) imgs <- list.files("www", pattern = "(?i)\\.(png|jpe?g|svg|gif|webp)$") if (!length(imgs)) return(NA_character_) pref <- imgs[grepl("(?i)logo|wsg|sea.?grant", imgs)] if (length(pref)) pref[1] else imgs[1] }) # Print what was found at launch so it's easy to diagnose from the Console. if (is.na(logo_file)) { message("WSG logo: no usable image found in www/ (contents: ", paste(if (dir.exists("www")) list.files("www") else "", collapse = ", "), ") — using text badge.") } else { message("WSG logo: using www/", logo_file) } header_brand <- if (!is.na(logo_file)) { tags$img(src = logo_file, height = "62px", alt = "Washington Sea Grant", style = "display:block;") } else { tags$span("WSG", style = paste0("font-weight:800; font-size:1.5em; letter-spacing:1px; color:white; ", "background:", WSG_PURPLE, "; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:4px;")) } # Light watermark drawn on every chart so screenshots carry the WSG attribution. watermark <- function() { mtext("Washington Sea Grant (WSG)", side = 3, line = -1.1, adj = 0.99, col = "#c9c9c9", cex = 0.75, font = 2) } # ---- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------ ui <- fluidPage( title = "WSG Recreational Boating Dashboard", tags$div( style = paste0("display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:10px 4px; ", "margin-bottom:10px; border-bottom:3px solid ", WSG_PURPLE, ";"), header_brand, tags$div( tags$div("Recreational Boating Dashboard", style = paste0("font-weight:700; font-size:1.2em; color:", WSG_PURPLE, ";")), tags$div("Washington State — monthly and rolling 12-month sales", style = "color:#555; font-size:0.9em;")) ), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( width = 3, conditionalPanel("input.tabs !== 'Explore'", selectInput("month", "Month", choices = setNames(1:12, month_names), selected = default_month), selectInput("year", "Year", choices = sort(unique(sales$year), decreasing = TRUE), selected = default_year) ), conditionalPanel("input.tabs === 'Explore'", tags$p("The Explore tab has its own filters above the charts.", style = "color:#666; font-size:0.9em;")) ), mainPanel( width = 9, tabsetPanel(id = "tabs", tabPanel("Monthly Summary", h4(textOutput("caption")), tableOutput("summary"), tags$p(textOutput("last_updated"), style = "color:#888; font-size:0.85em; margin-top:8px;") ), tabPanel("Rolling 12-Mo", if (length(source_levels)) tagList( checkboxGroupInput("r12_src", "Source of Sales", choices = source_levels, selected = source_levels, inline = TRUE), tags$div(style = "margin:-6px 0 10px; font-size:0.9em;", "Quick picks: ", actionLink("r12_pick_all", "All sources"), " · ", actionLink("r12_pick_new", "New (Dealer + Import)"), " · ", actionLink("r12_pick_used_dealer", "Used Dealer + Used Dealer Import")) ), h4(textOutput("r12_caption")), tableOutput("r12_table"), tags$p("Rolling 12-month (R12) sums the trailing 12 months, so it removes ", "seasonality and shows the underlying year-over-year trend. Leave a box empty to ", "include everything. ", "© ", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), " Washington Sea Grant — not for redistribution or reuse without attribution.")), style = paste0("color:#777; font-size:0.8em; text-align:center; padding:4px 0 12px;") ) ) # ---- Server -------------------------------------------------------------- server <- function(input, output, session) { # ---- Explore tab --------------------------------------------------------- observeEvent(input$ex_pick_coastal, updateSelectizeInput(session, "ex_moor_county", selected = intersect(coastal_counties, explore_choices[["Moorage County"]]))) observeEvent(input$ex_pick_county_clear, updateSelectizeInput(session, "ex_moor_county", selected = character(0))) observeEvent(input$ex_reset, { for (col in explore_dims) updateSelectizeInput(session, paste0("ex_", col), selected = character(0)) updateSliderInput(session, "ex_dates", value = c(default_start, date_max)) updateNumericInput(session, "ex_pmin", value = NA) updateNumericInput(session, "ex_pmax", value = NA) updateCheckboxInput(session, "ex_excl0", value = TRUE) }) ex_window <- reactive({ rng <- input$ex_dates if (is.null(rng)) rng <- c(default_start, date_max) c(date_to_ym(rng[1]), date_to_ym(rng[2])) }) # Records matching every filter. ex_data <- reactive({ req(records) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(records)) for (col in explore_dims) { sel <- input[[paste0("ex_", col)]] if (length(sel)) keep <- keep & as.character(records[[col]]) %in% sel } w <- ex_window() keep <- keep & records$ym >= w[1] & records$ym <= w[2] if (isTRUE(input$ex_pmin > 0)) keep <- keep & records$price >= input$ex_pmin if (isTRUE(!is.na(input$ex_pmax))) keep <- keep & records$price <= input$ex_pmax records[keep, ] }) priced <- function(d) if (isTRUE(input$ex_excl0)) d$price > 0 else rep(TRUE, nrow(d)) output$ex_kpis <- renderUI({ d <- ex_data(); p <- d$price[priced(d)] card <- function(label, val, sub = NULL) column(3, tags$div( style = "text-align:center; padding:10px 4px; margin:6px 0 12px; border:1px solid #e3e3e3; border-radius:6px;", tags$div(label, style = "color:#555; font-size:0.9em;"), tags$div(val, style = paste0("font-size:1.6em; font-weight:700; color:", WSG_PURPLE, ";")), if (!is.null(sub)) tags$div(sub, style = "color:#999; font-size:0.75em;"))) fluidRow( card("Boats Sold", fmt_int(nrow(d))), card("Total Sales Value", fmt_short_money(sum(d$price))), card("Average Price", if (length(p)) fmt_money(mean(p)) else "—", paste0("n = ", comma(length(p)))), card("Median Price", if (length(p)) fmt_money(median(p)) else "—", paste0("n = ", comma(length(p)))) ) }) # One row per category of the "Compare by" attribute. ex_summary <- reactive({ d <- ex_data(); y[is.na(y)] <- 0 col <- if (is_price) "#6aa84f" else "#4a6fa5" cols <- ifelse(is_price & s$n_priced < small_n, "#cfcfcf", col) lab_val <- if (met == "units") comma(y) else if (met == "value") paste0("$", formatC(y / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1), "M") else paste0("$", comma(y)) n_lab <- if (is_price) s$n_priced else s$units labs <- paste0(lab_val, " (n = ", comma(n_lab), ")") if (is_price) labs[s$n_priced == 0] <- "no priced sales" o <- rev(seq_len(nrow(s))) # first category on top par(mar = c(3, 12, 1, 1)) xmax <- max(y, 1) * 1.45 bp <- barplot(y[o], names.arg = s$group[o], horiz = TRUE, las = 1, col = cols[o], border = NA, xlim = c(0, xmax), cex.names = 0.85, xaxt = "n") ticks <- pretty(c(0, max(y, 1))) axis(1, at = ticks, cex.axis = 0.8, labels = if (met == "units") comma(ticks) else if (met == "value") paste0("$", ticks / 1e6, "M") else paste0("$", comma(ticks))) text(y[o], bp, labs[o], pos = 4, cex = 0.8, xpd = TRUE) watermark() }, height = ex_plot_height) output$ex_small_note <- renderText({ s <- ex_summary() if (is.null(s) || !(input$ex_metric %in% c("median", "avg"))) return("") if (any(s$n_priced > 0 & s$n_priced < small_n)) paste0("Gray bars are based on fewer than ", small_n, " sales; treat them with caution.") else "" }) output$ex_trend_title <- renderText({ m <- c(median = "Median price", avg = "Average price", units = "Boats sold", value = "Total sales value")[[input$ex_metric]] paste0(m, " by month (current filters)") }) output$ex_trend_plot <- renderPlot({ d <- ex_data() if (nrow(d) == 0) { blank("No sales match these filters."); return() } w <- ex_window(); yms <- w[1]:w[2] met <- input$ex_metric f <- factor(d$ym, levels = yms); pr <- priced(d) y <- switch(met, units = as.numeric(tapply(rep(1, nrow(d)), f, sum)), value = as.numeric(tapply(d$price, f, sum)) / 1e6, avg = as.numeric(tapply(d$price[pr], f[pr], mean)), median = as.numeric(tapply(d$price[pr], f[pr], median))) y[is.na(y)] <- 0 par(mar = c(5, 6, 1, 1)) bp <- barplot(y, names.arg = format(ym_to_date(yms), "%b %Y"), las = 2, border = NA, col = if (met %in% c("median", "avg")) "#6aa84f" else "#4a6fa5", cex.names = 0.75, yaxt = "n", ylim = c(0, max(y, 1) * 1.1)) tk <- axTicks(2) axis(2, at = tk, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8, labels = switch(met, units = comma(tk), value = paste0("$", tk, "M"), paste0("$", comma(tk)))) watermark() }) ex_table_df <- reactive({ s <- ex_summary(); if (is.null(s)) return(NULL) lbl <- names(explore_dims)[explore_dims == input$ex_group] df <- data.frame(s$group, s$units, s$value, s$avg, s$median, s$n_priced, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) names(df) <- c(lbl, "Boats Sold", "Total Sales Value", "Average Price", "Median Price", "Sales Used for Price Stats") df }) output$ex_table <- renderTable({ df <- ex_table_df(); if (is.null(df)) return(NULL) df[[2]] <- vapply(df[[2]], fmt_int, ""); df[[3]] <- vapply(df[[3]], fmt_money, "") df[[4]] <- vapply(df[[4]], fmt_money, ""); df[[5]] <- vapply(df[[5]], fmt_money, "") df[[6]] <- vapply(df[[6]], fmt_int, "") df }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, align = "lrrrrr", width = "100%") # Most common combinations of the chosen characteristics. output$ex_combos <- renderUI({ d <- ex_data(); dims <- input$ex_combo_dims if (!length(dims)) return(tags$p("Check at least one characteristic above.", style = "color:#888;")) if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tags$p("No sales match these filters.", style = "color:#888;")) dims <- combo_dims[combo_dims %in% dims] # keep a consistent order key <- do.call(paste, c(lapply(dims, function(col) as.character(d[[col]])), sep = "\r")) counts <- sort(table(key), decreasing = TRUE) top <- head(counts, as.integer(input$ex_combo_n)) total <- nrow(d); name: prepare_data.R
content:
# Prep step for Recreational Boating Dashboard 1
# Reads the full Rec Boating xlsx, keeps only the fields this dashboard needs,
# aggregates to monthly units + value, and writes a small boat_sales.csv.
# Re-run this whenever new data is added. Source: Kevin Decker | rec boating dashboards

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---- Config --------------------------------------------------------------
# Point this at your live file. Update the path if it moves.
input_path  <- "/Users/kevindecker/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-kadecker@uw.edu/My Drive/Recreational Boating/Rec Boating Data.xlsx"
output_path <- "boat_sales.csv"            # monthly totals -> Monthly Summary tab
source_path <- "boat_sales_by_source.csv"  # monthly totals by source -> Trends tab

# Which date drives a "sale": use the transaction fields (default).
# To key off purchase instead, change to "Purchase Year" / (no month) below.
year_col   <- "Transaction Year"
month_col  <- "Transaction Month Value"   # numeric 1-12
value_col  <- "Purchase Cost"
source_col <- "Source of Sales"           # e.g. "Used Private", "New Dealer"

# ---- Read ----------------------------------------------------------------
message("Reading ", input_path, " ...")
raw <- read_excel(input_path, guess_max = 100000)

needed <- c(year_col, month_col, value_col, source_col)
missing <- setdiff(needed, names(raw))
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("These expected columns weren't found: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       "\nColumns in file: ", paste(names(raw), collapse = " | "))
}

# ---- Aggregate -----------------------------------------------------------
summary <- raw %>%
  transmute(
    year  = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[year_col]])),
    month = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[month_col]])),
    value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[value_col]]))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month), month >= 1, month <= 12) %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    units = n(),                          # boats sold = number of transactions
    value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),     # sales value = sum of purchase cost
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, month)

# ---- Monthly totals by source (for the Trends tab) -----------------------
by_source <- raw %>%
  transmute(
    year   = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[year_col]])),
    month  = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[month_col]])),
    value  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[value_col]])),
    source = as.character(.data[[source_col]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month), month >= 1, month <= 12) %>%
  mutate(source = ifelse(is.na(source) | trimws(source) == "",
                         "Unknown", trimws(source))) %>%
  group_by(year, month, source) %>%
  summarise(units = n(), value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(year, month, source)

# ---- Reconciliation check ------------------------------------------------
# Both files are cut from the same rows, so monthly units and value must match
# between the totals and the by-source file. A mismatch means a bad/partial
# upload — surface it loudly rather than ship it.
recon <- summary %>%
  rename(units_total = units, value_total = value) %>%
  left_join(by_source %>% group_by(year, month) %>%
              summarise(units_src = sum(units), value_src = sum(value), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("year", "month"))

bad <- recon %>%
  filter(units_total != units_src | abs(value_total - value_src) >= 1)

if (nrow(bad) == 0) {
  message("Reconciliation OK: monthly units and value match between the totals and by-source files.")
} else {
  warning("RECONCILIATION MISMATCH in ", nrow(bad),
          " month(s) — check the source file. Offending rows:")
  print(as.data.frame(head(bad, 10)))
}

# ---- Write ---------------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(summary, output_path)
write_csv(by_source, source_path)
message("Working directory: ", getwd())
message("Wrote ", nrow(summary), " month rows to: ", normalizePath(output_path),
        "  (", min(summary$year), "-", max(summary$year), ")")
message("Wrote ", nrow(by_source), " source rows to: ", normalizePath(source_path))
message("Done. Open those files, or re-run app.R to see the update.")
print(tail(summary, 6))
